in_sanskrit.name: शर्हणी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharhaani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharah', which means 'victorious in battles'. The suffix 'ani' means 'she who' or 'one who'. Thus, Sharhaani can be interpreted as 'she who is victorious in battles' or 'one who is prosperous'. This name is often given to baby girls in Hindu communities to instill a sense of strength and victory.

in_hindi.name: शरहानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharhaani in Hindi translates to 'vijayi srastaa', which means 'one who creates victory'. This name is often given to baby girls to inspire them to overcome challenges and achieve success in their lives.

in_tamil.name: ஷரகாணி
